description: The Fama-French factors from Kenneth French's data library at Dartmouth: the market over the T-bill (Mkt-RF), size (SMB), value (HML), profitability (RMW), investment (CMA) and momentum (Mom), with the one-month T-bill rate (RF), monthly since 1926, daily or by year, as fractions ready for a factor regression.

end.description: Last period. Default the latest published.

model.description: ff3 (market, size, value), ff5 (adds profitability and investment), momentum, carhart (ff3 and momentum) or ff5_momentum. Default ff3.

start.description: First period: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. Default ten years before the latest (one year for daily; every year for annual).

name: factor_returns

outputSchema.description: rows are periods, oldest first, with each factor's return as a fraction in the order of columns.

title: Fama-French factors
